After defender wins: attacker loses half remaining force rounded down; resolve defeated-plan effects. Skip attacker targets. Then resolve defender’s victorious effects. Finally discard any plans from either side that say “At end, discard.” Thus the attacker’s end-discard plan is discarded despite losing.

given_state: Attacker loses; defender has an “If you’re victorious” plan; both sides have “At end, discard” plans.
completed_events: Battle roll and defeat have occurred; attacker is defeated.
next_operation: Resolve defeat effects after casualties; skip attacker targets; resolve defender victory effects; discard all plans marked “At end, discard.”
result: Defender’s victorious effect resolves; attacker’s plan does not survive merely because attacker lost.

Gradient means either side may use it. Either eligible user may choose to add or remove the die shown by ±; it is not assigned by role. The ± sign does not convert attack dice into defense dice.
A Wake power without “may” is not skippable; resolve as much as possible. Rest powers are optional once each. Opportunity-site income explicitly is optional.

Red rules the separate faceup site containing red warbands and its cards, even with pawn elsewhere. Purple-garrisoned site and its cards are ruled by Imperial players, including Chancellor; Red does not rule it just by pawn presence. Moving pawn alone does not change rule; physical warbands determine it. Sites hold only one color, so red and purple warbands cannot coexist to share one site.
